basics.name: Zhaoxin Meng
basics.summary: I’m an Industrial PhD at Einride and a Doctoral Researcher at Chalmers and the University of Gothenburg, with a current research focus on AI agents.

work.summary: Industrial PhD with the joint Department of Computer Science and Engineering at Chalmers and the University of Gothenburg, funded by SSF.

highlights: As Navigation Project Manager, I led localization, perception, and planning, guiding the team to break multiple human world records in the 100 m, 400 m, and 1500 m events.
Developed and led the perception algorithms, helping the team finish in the top six and break the human world record.

work.summary: Focused on occupancy tasks, scene understanding, and data for autonomous driving.
